definition.source: Explicit saved original face IDs, original_source_faces, and C_source_corner_permutations; no score-based C direction selection
definition.changes: Only first K face rows receive their exact per-face inverse corner permutation; all free face rows unchanged at this stage
definition.identity: Source face row order and source vertex IDs are explicitly checked, not inferred from coincident coordinates
definition.coordinates: All vertex-array bytes unchanged; original source C order in existing model coordinates restored exactly
definition.corner_attributes: Apply the same output-slot-to-input-slot permutation to every saved per-corner attribute; compose subsequent free reversals
definition.limitations: Changes the old ordered-canonical-C export contract; does not move vertices, certify outward normals/manifoldness, or improve geometric attachment
